at1733_pre_gate.description: AT-1733 PASSED: 4 loop-carried coopmat accumulators in ONE K-loop emit exactly 4 well-formed OpPhi in ONE loop header. Each phi has 7 words (2 predecessor pairs), all 4 result_ids are distinct (e.g. [%42,%43,%44,%45]), both predecessors are valid OpLabel ids, spirv-val Vulkan_1_1 clean. NO codegen change was required — the parallel pre_header_values/latch_values/carried Vec machinery in emit_for_range is N-agnostic as the architect verified. Pre-gate LOCKED.

rb_kernel_design.block_size: RB_M=2, RB_N=2 — 32×32 output block (4 tiles of 16×16)
rb_kernel_design.accumulators: acc_00, acc_01, acc_10, acc_11 — all in ONE K-loop
rb_kernel_design.index_recovery: block_col = gid(0u32) / 32u32; block_row = gid(1u32); lane = subgroup_invocation_id()
rb_kernel_design.asymmetric: YES — divide x by 32, do NOT divide y (same idiom as M3.3b)
rb_kernel_design.shared_a: a_tile: shared[f16, 512] — 32 rows × 16 cols (block_row*32 rows, k_block*16 cols), stride 16
rb_kernel_design.shared_b: b_tile: shared[f16, 512] — 16 rows × 32 cols (k_block*16 rows, block_col*32 cols), stride 32
rb_kernel_design.staging_a: a_iters=16; ei_a = iter*32+lane; a_row=ei_a/16; a_col=ei_a-a_row*16; A_global_row=block_row*32+a_row; A_global_col=k_block*tile_k+a_col; a_tile[ei_a]=A[A_global_row*K+A_global_col]
rb_kernel_design.staging_b: b_iters=16; ei_b = iter*32+lane; b_row=ei_b/32; b_col=ei_b-b_row*32; B_global_row=k_block*tile_k+b_row; B_global_col=block_col*32+b_col; b_tile[ei_b]=B[B_global_row*N+B_global_col]

coopmat_loads.b_mat_1: coopmat_load(b_tile, 16u32, 32u32) — cols 16..32 of B block (offset=1*16=16, stride=32)

honesty_gate.statement: The bench reports the REAL measured TFLOPS at each size (256³, 512³, 768³). If RB does NOT beat 5.04 at any size, the coder.json says so. Bit-exactness (max_diff==0.0) is non-negotiable — QA must not relax this. The occupancy tradeoff is explicitly documented in DESIGN §3.1.17 and ROADMAP M3.3c.
honesty_gate.tflops_placeholder: QA fills in the ACTUAL measured TFLOPS after GPU run. No placeholder claim of 'competitive' is made here.
honesty_gate.no_cherry_pick: The bench measures at ALL three sizes and reports ALL. The 256³ result is NOT hidden if it regresses.

known_issue_discovered.issue: strip_strategy_annotation_block in axc-driver/src/lib.rs finds the FIRST occurrence of '@strategy' in the source text. If '@strategy' appears in comments before the actual annotation, it matches the comment (which has no '{' after it) and returns the source UNCHANGED — leaving the @strategy annotation un-stripped, causing UnresolvedStrategyHole error.
known_issue_discovered.fix_applied: Removed '@strategy' from all comments in matmul_rb_coopmat.axc. Changed 'a @strategy hole' to 'a strategy hole' and 'The @strategy holes' to 'The strategy holes' in the file header comments.
known_issue_discovered.root_cause_not_fixed: The underlying bug in strip_strategy_annotation_block is not fixed in M3.3c (it would be a separate fix). Coder workaround: avoid '@strategy' in .axc file comments. This is safe for existing files (matmul_shared_coopmat.axc doesn't mention '@strategy' in comments).

self_assessment.spec_coverage: All items from M3.3c-architect.json implemented: AT-1733 pre-gate, RB kernel (matmul_rb_coopmat.axc), AT-1731/1732 bit-exact dispatch tests, AT-1734 compile anchor, AT-1730 honest TFLOPS bench, DESIGN §3.1.17 occupancy note, ROADMAP M3.3c entry.
known_limitations: strip_strategy_annotation_block comment-matching bug not fixed (workaround: avoid '@strategy' in .axc comments). Filed as discovery, not blocking.

AT-1730 TFLOPS numbers not yet measured (requires GPU). Honest predictions: 256³ may regress vs 5.04; 512³/768³ expected to improve.
2×4 and 4×4 RB variants not shipped (optional stretch per spec, 2×2 is the required variant).
deviations: resident_matmul_rb.rs bench function measure_rb_tflops wraps the per-size measurement logic for 256³/512³/768³ (cleaner than copy-paste). The criterion bench_function iter_custom still uses the 256³ timing for criterion's duration bookkeeping.
